verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's own materials say you can self-host with Docker for free, deploy on your own infrastructure or on-premise, and run the desktop app entirely on your machine. Release notes mention Kubernetes probes, and community users report running it locally and deploying customized instances in enterprise environments. missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting/deployment documentation (Docker/k8s setup guides) in the evidence pack.
